title: Italian prime minister on the church–state–mafia triumvirate

tellings.quote: Okay? So yes, there was a triumpvirate that ran Italy for a long time and it was an alliance of the pope, the Vatican, the elected government and the cityian market.

plain: A former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren says that in Rome in 1973 the prime minister of Italy described to him how the country was really run: by an alliance of three powers, the pope and the Vatican, the elected government, and a third power the story names as the mafia. Malmgren tells it as something he heard first-hand, saying "there was a triumvirate that ran Italy for a long time," which would mean the country's real power sat partly outside its government.
